title: Hula 7000 Triple Blue Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: The Hula 7000 Triple Blue Prefilled pod layers three distinctive berry notes into one vibrant mix. Sweet Blueberry and tart Blue Raspberry combine with a sharper berry undertone, delivering a tangy yet juicy vape that remains balanced and moreish. Designed for the Hula Prefilled Pod System Kit, these pods let you swap flavours quickly without mess. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid, topped up automatically from the integrated 10ml refill reservoir, so you’ll never have to refill bottles or change coils. Altogether you’ll enjoy 12ml of e-liquid with up to 7000 puffs (approx.), supported by dual mesh coil technology to keep the flavour consistent. Insert into your Hula kit and enjoy a bright, berry-led vape that lasts. Available in 20 satisfying flavours, these replacement pods are perfect for keeping your vape fresh and flavourful.
